- Inventory space (28 slots) limits hides per trip – deposited gloves at bank to free space

- Pre-stack 14-20 hides, tan all, then craft all within one 15s sample → 14*345=4830 raw = 96 XP/min theoretical peak
- Crafting leather bodies requires 3 leather each, lower XP/leather, so gloves remain optimal for pure XP rate
